entrypoints.summary: A malicious custom or modified Signal client sends an Admin Delete DataMessage with attacker-selected groupV2 context, target sent timestamp, and target-author ACI.

affected_components.role: Pre-fix handler resolves a target without thread scoping and authorizes it using the inbound group; fixed handler binds the target's thread to inbound context.

causal_paths.kind: pre-fix target lookup to destructive deletion

code_slices.fixed: The fixed handler obtains targetThread from targetMessage.threadId, rejects a targetThread recipient that differs from threadRecipient.id, then loads groupRecord from the target thread recipient.
code_slices.surrounding_context: Admin Delete processing is gated by RemoteConfig.receiveAdminDelete and validates that the resolved group record is a V2 group before checking deletion constraints.
code_slices.vulnerable: The pre-fix handler looks up targetMessage using target timestamp and target author, obtains groupRecord from threadRecipient.id, then conditionally marks targetMessage as remotely deleted.

negative_controls: The bundle contains no captured before/after runtime trace or executable test result.
observability.positive_marker: The reported target message is marked as remotely deleted on the victim device.

preconditions: The sender can use a custom or modified Signal client to construct an Admin Delete DataMessage.
The sender is an administrator in a supplied Group A and can identify a target message's sent timestamp and author ACI, such as through membership in the target group or a reported 1:1 relationship.
The recipient has the target message locally and processes the Admin Delete feature path.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: groupV2 references a group in which the sender is an administrator; adminDelete contains targetSentTimestamp and targetAuthorAciBinary for a message in a different conversation.
trigger_steps.summary: Send an Admin Delete DataMessage naming Group A in groupV2 and naming the target's timestamp and author ACI.

capabilities.concept: remote deletion of a target message

mitigations.concept: target-thread identity binding for Admin Delete authorization

relation_candidates.rationale: The inbound group context can name a group where the sender is an administrator even when the resolved target belongs to a different thread.

relation_candidates.dst: remote deletion of a target message
relation_candidates.rationale: After validation against the supplied group record, the handler calls markAsRemoteDelete for the resolved target.
The report's receiver-side trace states that the deletion removes the target Group B message despite administrator status only in Group A.
relation_candidates.src: remote deletion of a target message

relation_candidates.dst: target-thread identity binding for Admin Delete authorization
relation_candidates.rationale: The patch rejects mismatched target and supplied thread recipients before group lookup and destructive deletion.

impact.affected_asset: Integrity and availability of stored conversation messages on the victim device.
impact.attacker_capability: Reuse administrator status in one group to authorize an Admin Delete against a timestamp-and-author-matched message in another group or reported 1:1 conversation.
impact.security_effect: Unauthorized remote deletion of a message on a recipient device across conversation/thread boundaries.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker who is an administrator of Group A and can observe a target message's timestamp and author ACI supplies Group A as groupV2 context while identifying a message in Group B or another conversation.
The pre-fix handler resolves the target by sent timestamp and author identity without a thread filter, while loading the group record from the inbound, attacker-supplied thread recipient.
isValidAdminDeleteReceive evaluates administrator status using the supplied Group A record and, when accepted, the handler invokes markAsRemoteDelete on the resolved target message.
A Group A administrator can cause deletion of the matching target message from Group B or another conversation on the victim device, subject to knowing the target timestamp and author ACI.

failure.operation: SignalDatabase.messages.markAsRemoteDelete(targetMessage, senderRecipient.id) after authorization against the inbound thread's group record

primary_invariant.statement: Authority to perform an Admin Delete must be evaluated against the same thread/group that owns the resolved target message.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The vulnerable path obtains the target globally by timestamp and author but derives the authorization group record from the inbound threadRecipient, permitting an administrator of a different group to satisfy the authorization check.

quality.review_notes: The disclosure provides a concrete crafted-message trace and the primary code and patch corroborate the cross-thread binding flaw. No standalone packet fixture, custom-client PoC, runtime execution result, or issue-specific regression test is present in this bundle; therefore no runnable harness or passing/failing test outcome is claimed. The pre-fix source is used as comparative handler evidence, but its exact ancestry relative to the cited release scope is not independently established here.

remediation.invariant_restored: The fixed handler resolves the target message's thread, returns without deletion when its recipient differs from the inbound threadRecipient, and obtains the group record using the target thread recipient.
mitigation_classes: bind authorization context to resolved target thread
reject Admin Delete requests when supplied and target thread recipients differ
derive group authorization record from target thread

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Signal for Android >= v8.1.0 and < v8.3.0; tested v8.2.2
